summary: Unilever PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting ongoing share repurchases under its existing buyback program. Between 30 April and 1 May 2026, the company purchased 3,298,461 ordinary shares across multiple trading venues at volume-weighted average prices ranging from 4,277.81 to 4,383.93 pence per share. The repurchased shares will be held in treasury, reducing shares outstanding and returning capital to shareholders. This is a routine open-market buyback execution, not a tender offer or structural change. Watch for continued buyback pace as a signal of capital allocation priorities.
